task_metadata.research_topic: multi-task loss combination for hierarchical fine/coarse CIFAR-100 classification
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel multi-task loss combination strategy for jointly training fine-grained (100-class) and coarse (20-superclass) classification on CIFAR-100 that maximizes fine-class test accuracy.
notes: The DWA baseline is linked to the MTAN paper, which explicitly introduces Dynamic Weight Average in the task description and experiments.
The CIFAR-100 source paper resolves through a DOI-backed mirror of Krizhevsky's original tiny-images technical report.
